answer: Attention Rationing Mechanism resists sybil attacks by requiring each identity to maintain a visible, time-bound attention deposit in the form of a public forum post or debate contribution. Can an attacker sustain infinite such posts without losing credibility or community trust? The canyon of real-time scrutiny and the mirror of public record force them to invest scarce attention, while quartz-like rigidity in the rule ensures no identity can bypass the cost through automation or sockpuppetry.
